subject: Startups
title: Unit Economics: The Hidden Truth
description: A fast breakdown of Unit Economics: The Hidden Truth for builders.

hook.text: DoorDash lost money on every delivery for years. How does a company survive losing money on each transaction?

buildup.text: Unit economics measure the profit or loss per individual transaction. Healthy units mean each sale adds value.

discovery.text: Startups lose on unit economics early by subsidizing users.

twist.text: If unit economics never turn positive, growth just accelerates losses. More customers means losing more money faster.

climax.text: MoviePass had catastrophic unit economics: selling $10 movie tickets for $10/month.

punchline.text: Growth without unit economics is organized money-burning.

quiz.question: What are unit economics?
options: Profit or loss per individual transaction
